serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I wonder if the church survived these recent events…
I’m also worried about Shanice and Priestbot. {{wi}}Well, less about Priestbot since he seems like he can take care of himself.
Shanice on the other hand…
I don’t want to sound rude, but she always seemed like an airhead. 
For crying out loud. She wears that nun cosplay all the time, even outside!
I’m getting close now.
From the outside it looks the same as before, but to be honest I probably wouldn’t be able to tell if someone did any damage since this church has been run down ever since I can remember.…
